title: Q-ROOT-repeated-failure: repeated-failure keeps recurring: Apply the loop-breaker: change the tool, path or abstraction named in the item, not the retry count.
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it when a root cause recurs; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe repeated-failure
**Status:** open

Root cause class `repeated-failure` recurred on 8 days (2026-11-21, 2026-11-22, 2026-11-23, 2026-11-24, 2026-11-25, 2026-11-26, 2026-11-27, 2026-11-28); the guard exists and the failure still returned: the guard is ineffective, so redesign it (a fourth attempt of the same fix is not allowed).
Root cause: a loop failed the same way again and no change altered the approach
Guard: `grep:foundation/failure_audit.py::def _mode`
Remedy: Apply the loop-breaker: change the tool, path or abstraction named in the item, not the retry count.
Symptoms seen:
- temporal:67d6a95a40: ledger:clocks:all all: 566 failures in a row, 260 in the last 3 days against 222 in the 14 before
- temporal:4f9b20023a: ledger:executor:pr-outcome pr-outcome: last event 10 h ago, it used to arrive every 1.8 h (5.8 intervals)
- temporal:3230293be3: ledger:deploys:ultrastable-seed-second-tenant ultrastable-seed-second-tenant: 0 failures in a row, 22 in the last 3 days
Fix the root, not the symptom: the item closes when the guard passes and the class stays quiet for 2 days.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rootcause --probe repeated-failure
